custom_tools.name: line_count
custom_tools.description: Count the number of lines in a file. Use this when you need to know how many lines a file has.

path.description: Path to the file to count lines in

custom_tools.name: word_count
custom_tools.description: Count the number of words in a file. Use this when you need to know how many words a file has.

path.description: Path to the file to count words in

custom_tools.name: make_target
custom_tools.description: Run a make target in the project. Use this when you need to build, test, or run any make target.

target.description: The make target to run (e.g. build, test, fmt)

cwd.description: Working directory to run make in (optional)

custom_tools.name: git_branch
custom_tools.description: List git branches in the current repository. Use this when you need to see available branches.

custom_tools.name: cargo_test_filtered
custom_tools.description: Run a filtered cargo test. Use this when you need to run a specific test by name.
